scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web "npm run dev --workspace @kvg/api" "npm run dev --workspace @kvg/web"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kvg/contracts && npm run build --workspace @kvg/api && npm run build --workspace @kvg/web
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @kvg/api && npm run test --workspace @kvg/api
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run build && npm run test --workspace @kvg/api && npm run test:web
scripts.check:supabase: npm run build --workspace @kvg/api && npm run check:supabase --workspace @kvg/api
scripts.test:identity:live: npm run build --workspace @kvg/api && npm run test:identity:live --workspace @kvg/api
scripts.setup:records:dev: npm run build --workspace @kvg/api && npm run setup:records:dev --workspace @kvg/api
scripts.test:records:live: npm run build --workspace @kvg/api && npm run test:records:live --workspace @kvg/api
